description: Reads a site's Referrer-Policy header and its <meta name=referrer> tag from the home page, works out the policy a browser would apply, and rates how much of the URL it sends to other sites (strict, moderate or leaky). One GET; links on other pages can set their own policy. Related tools on this server, for a different need: security_csp_evaluator_audit when you need to read the Content-Security-Policy header of a site's home; security_bimi_record_audit when you need to read a domain's BIMI record: whether it is published. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
